column1: # Token values per colour scheme. OKLCH throughout: it interpolates without
# the muddy midpoints hex gives you, and a lightness change stays a lightness
# change instead of quietly shifting hue.
# TOKEN NAMES are shared across every site in the family. VALUES are not, and
# must not be: two sites that look identical are two sites nobody can tell
# apart, and a shared palette means fixing one breaks the other silently.
# An instance overrides values in its own theme.css.
